author: NBASLIME
quote: For a game that was in the makings for 13 years and was delayed by 3 years, the expectations were high and not delivered. What we got was basically a lesser version of RDR2. Making GTA a couples game, which restricts the player from a lot of actions that were available in previous games was a terrible decision. The "realism" makes the game harder to play as the star system has made it more difficult to get away from police and make the game less enjoyable. The decision to make a vehicle the "main" vehicle of the character is ridiculous, guns and clothes are then limited to a lesser version of what it was with horses in RDR2, it simply doesn't work. I was going to give this a 3, but after writing this paragraph I have realized that 2 billion dollars were wasted on this. 0/10
